version_name: WP5 impact assessment: narrative and report
features: WP5 indicator registry: 95 indicators with D5.2 provenance; Standard Entry indicator fields and picker; drift warning and review on load (WS-4).
Posidonia oceanica valuation calculator under Response & Validation: D5.2 Table 19 values, discounted totals, restoration cost, survival-adjusted break-even, Excel export (WS-5).
WP5 impact assessment: deterministic trade-off narrative (step 6) and Word/Excel report with mechanism and provenance appendices (step 7) (WS-6c).

high: Auto-save backups wrote empty fields without null, so recovery could drop a whole element category; the loader now binds rows by key union, so older backups recover too (WS-4).

migration_notes: Projects that use a WP5 indicator are stamped min_app_version 1.24.0; 1.23.0 and older would drop the indicator columns on save.
